plain: A secret deal to cheat or deceive others

webster.text: In law, a deceitful agreement or compact between two or more persons, for the one party to bring an action against the other, for some evil purpose, as to defraud a third person of his right.

example.quote: They may be all present when he is impeached, and other senators in the mean time introduced The chief justice, we ought to presume, would not countenance a collusion.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. MACLAINE, July 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
